CheckTitle: Ensure no customer managed IAM policies allow actions that may lead to privilege escalation
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/Identity and Access Management
Description: Checks customer-managed policies for action combinations known to allow privilege escalation (e.g. iam:CreatePolicyVersion, iam:PassRole + ec2:RunInstances).
Risk: An identity holding escalation primitives can grant itself administrator rights, defeating least privilege.

Recommendation.Text: Remove privilege-escalation actions or constrain them with resource ARNs, conditions and permission boundaries.

Notes: Not a numbered CIS AWS 3.0 control; mapped to 1.16 (least privilege / no full admin).
